summary: Rhinebeck Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing a public stock offering of up to 8,912,500 shares at $10.00 per share as part of a second-step conversion from mutual holding company to stock holding company structure. The subscription offering is available to eligible depositors and employee benefit plans, with subsequent community and public offerings if undersubscribed. Minimum sale of 6,587,500 shares required. Completion subject to regulatory approvals and shareholder/depositor approvals. Keefe Bruyette Woods acts as marketing agent. This is a mutual-to-stock conversion, not a standard capital return or special situation; it is a routine regulatory-structure event, thus 'None'.
